<thought>Search for a retrosynthetic template that corresponds to a Diels‑Alder cycloaddition (formation of a six‑membered ring, bond order change from double to single). This requires bonds formed between two sp2 carbons (6‑6) and a bond order change 6‑6 (2.0->1.0). We'll query the template catalog with these criteria for the target molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O",
    "bonds_formed": ["6-6"],
    "bonds_order_changed": ["6-6 (2.0->1.0)"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
